mapper.select: SELECT mr.MedicalID as medicalId, am.ApptID as apptId, mr.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, mr.MedicalTime as medicalTime, mr.Diagnosis as diagnosis, mr.MedicalFee as medicalFee, e.EmpName as empName, s.StoreName as storeName FROM medicalRecord mr LEFT JOIN pet p ON mr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN employee e ON mr.EmpID = e.EmpID LEFT JOIN store s ON mr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN apptMedical am ON mr.MedicalID = am.MedicalID WHERE p.UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY mr.MedicalTime DESC

SELECT mr.MedicalID as medicalId, mr.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, p.Breed as breed, u.UserID as userId, u.UserName as userName, mr.EmpID as empId, e.EmpName as empName, mr.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, mr.MedicalTime as medicalTime, mr.Diagnosis as diagnosis, mr.MedicalFee as medicalFee, IFNULL(a.ApptStatus, '无预约') as status FROM medicalRecord mr LEFT JOIN pet p ON mr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN employee e ON mr.EmpID = e.EmpID LEFT JOIN store s ON mr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN apptMedical am ON mr.MedicalID = am.MedicalID LEFT JOIN appointment a ON am.ApptID = a.ApptID WHERE mr.EmpID = #{empId} ORDER BY mr.MedicalTime DESC

SELECT mr.MedicalID as medicalId, mr.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, p.Breed as breed, u.UserID as userId, u.UserName as userName, mr.EmpID as empId, e.EmpName as empName, mr.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, mr.MedicalTime as medicalTime, mr.Diagnosis as diagnosis, mr.MedicalFee as medicalFee, IFNULL(a.ApptStatus, '无预约') as status FROM medicalRecord mr LEFT JOIN pet p ON mr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN employee e ON mr.EmpID = e.EmpID LEFT JOIN store s ON mr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN apptMedical am ON mr.MedicalID = am.MedicalID LEFT JOIN appointment a ON am.ApptID = a.ApptID ORDER BY mr.MedicalTime DESC

SELECT mr.MedicalID as medicalId, mr.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, p.Breed as breed, p.Gender as gender, p.BirthDate as birthDate, u.UserID as userId, u.UserName as userName, u.Phone as userPhone, mr.EmpID as empId, e.EmpName as empName, e.EmpPhone as empPhone, e.Position as empPosition, mr.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, s.StoreAddress as storeAddress, s.StorePhone as storePhone, mr.MedicalTime as medicalTime, mr.Diagnosis as diagnosis, mr.Medication as medication, mr.MedicalFee as medicalFee, mr.FollowUpAdvice as followUpAdvice, IFNULL(a.ApptStatus, '无预约') as status FROM medicalRecord mr LEFT JOIN pet p ON mr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN employee e ON mr.EmpID = e.EmpID LEFT JOIN store s ON mr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN apptMedical am ON mr.MedicalID = am.MedicalID LEFT JOIN appointment a ON am.ApptID = a.ApptID WHERE mr.MedicalID = #{medicalId}

SELECT mr.MedicalID as medicalId, mr.PetID as petId, p.PetName as petName, p.Breed as breed, u.UserID as userId, u.UserName as userName, mr.EmpID as empId, e.EmpName as empName, mr.StoreID as storeId, s.StoreName as storeName, mr.MedicalTime as medicalTime, mr.Diagnosis as diagnosis, mr.MedicalFee as medicalFee, IFNULL(a.ApptStatus, '无预约') as status FROM medicalRecord mr LEFT JOIN pet p ON mr.PetID = p.PetID LEFT JOIN user u ON p.UserID = u.UserID LEFT JOIN employee e ON mr.EmpID = e.EmpID LEFT JOIN store s ON mr.StoreID = s.StoreID LEFT JOIN apptMedical am ON mr.MedicalID = am.MedicalID LEFT JOIN appointment a ON am.ApptID = a.ApptID WHERE p.UserID = #{userId} ORDER BY mr.MedicalTime DESC
